moments.quote: We lost one of the greats of stage and screen today. And, in my book, a tremendous friend and man. I learned so much from him. I will miss you, Patrick Stewart, all of my days.

moments.author: WorldStar Hip Hop / WSHH
moments.quote: #NEWS: Duane “Keefe D” Davis has been transferred to Nevada’s maximum‑security High Desert State Prison after receiving 40 years to life for his role in the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur. Davis, 63, was moved from a Las Vegas jail on October 22, according to the Nevada Department of Corrections. He was convicted of first‑degree murder in August and sentenced on October 13. His legal team plans to appeal the conviction.
moments.why: It went viral because it delivered breaking updates on a high‑profile case involving Tupac’s killer, condensing key facts into one attention‑grabbing post.
